+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DocumentServiceConfig:
+    api_key: Optional[str] = None
+    base_url: str = "https://api.veryfi.com/api/v7"
+    timeout: float = 60.0
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_env(cls) -> "DocumentServiceConfig":
+        return cls(
+            api_key=os.getenv("VERYFI_API_KEY"),
+            base_url=os.getenv("VERYFI_BASE_URL", "https://api.veryfi.com/api/v7"),
+            timeout=float(os.getenv("VERYFI_TIMEOUT", "60")),
+        )
+
+
+class DocumentClient:
+    def __init__(self, config: Optional[DocumentServiceConfig] = None) -> None:
+        self.config = config or DocumentServiceConfig.from_env()
+        self._session = requests.Session()
+        self._session.headers.update({"Accept": "application/json"})
+        if self.config.api_key:
+            self._session.headers.update({"Authorization": f"apikey {self.config.api_key}"})
+
+    def _request(self, method: str, path: str, **kwargs: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        url = f"{self.config.base_url.rstrip('/')}/{path.lstrip('/')}"
+        response = self._session.request(method, url, timeout=self.config.timeout, **kwargs)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        if response.content:
+            return response.json()
+        return {}
+
+    def extract_text(self, image_bytes: bytes, filename: str = "document") -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        files = {"file": (filename, image_bytes)}
+        return self._request("POST", "/partner/documents", files=files)
+
+    def extract_layout(self, image_bytes: bytes, filename: str = "document") -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        files = {"file": (filename, image_bytes)}
+        params = {"fields": "layout"}
+        return self._request("POST", "/partner/documents", files=files, params=params)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self._session.close()
+
+    def __enter__(self) -> "DocumentClient":
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb) -> None:
+        self.close()
+
+
+def get_document_client() -> DocumentClient:
+    return DocumentClient()
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai
+
+
+def _project_location_processor_path(project_id: str, location: str, processor_id: str) -> str:
+    return f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/processors/{processor_id}"
+
+
+def _get_client() -> documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient:
+    return documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
+
+
+def extract_key_values_from_bytes(
+    content: bytes,
+    mime_type: str,
+    project_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    location: Optional[str] = None,
+    processor_id: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    project_id = project_id or os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"]
+    location = location or os.environ.get("DOCUMENTAI_LOCATION", "us")
+    processor_id = processor_id or os.environ["DOCUMENTAI_PROCESSOR_ID"]
+
+    client = _get_client()
+    name = _project_location_processor_path(project_id, location, processor_id)
+    raw_document = documentai.RawDocument(content=content, mime_type=mime_type)
+    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=name, raw_document=raw_document)
+    result = client.process_document(request=request)
+
+    fields: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    document = result.document
+    for entity in document.entities:
+        key = entity.type_ or ""
+        value = entity.mention_text or ""
+        confidence = float(entity.confidence) if entity.confidence is not None else None
+        fields.append({"key": key, "value": value, "confidence": confidence})
+    return fields
+
+
+def extract_key_values_from_uri(
+    gcs_uri: str,
+    mime_type: str,
+    project_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    location: Optional[str] = None,

import urllib.request
from typing import Optional


GOOGLE_VISION_ENDPOINT = "https://vision.googleapis.com/v1/images:annotate"


def extract_text(image_path: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    key = api_key or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY")
    if not key:
        raise ValueError("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY is required")
    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
        image_b64 = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("ascii")
    payload = {
        "requests": [
            {
                "image": {"content": image_b64},
                "features": [{"type": "TEXT_DETECTION"}],
            }
        ]
    }
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    url = f"{GOOGLE_VISION_ENDPOINT}?key={key}"
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=data,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        method="POST",
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
        result = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    responses = result.get("responses", [])
    if not responses:
        return ""
    annotation = responses[0]
    if "error" in annotation:
        message = annotation["error"].get("message", "Google Vision OCR error")
        raise RuntimeError(message)
    text = annotation.get("fullTextAnnotation", {}).get("text")
    if text:
        return text
    return annotation.get("textAnnotations", [{}])[0].get("description", "")

+

+        endpoint = f"https://textract.{self.region}.amazonaws.com/"
+        headers = {

+            "X-Amz-Target": "Textract.AnalyzeDocument",
+        }
+        payload = {
